_doc: ARENA SIZES. Every fought room gets a seeded arena size/shape (ArenaGen.pick): w/h ranges per room type, minus ambush_shrink for ambush rooms, plus stage_grow[stage_idx] on the upper bound, plus big_bonus if any enemy has >= big_hp max HP (clamped to min/max). Shapes cut tiles into 'void' (never drawn, never walkable): rect, chamfer (all four corners cut), L (one corner block cut). Terrain blob/obstacle counts scale with area / ref_area. camera: the board is auto-fit to the view band at the largest zoom step that fits (sprites are 4x pixel art: 1.0 = 4x, 0.75 = 3x, 0.5 = 2x), the player can change zoom with the mouse wheel and pan with the arrow keys / middle-drag.
